purpose: Simulator development only; not approved for operational reliance
basis: Development proposal Sections 8 and Appendix A; all numeric parameters are engineering test assumptions, not mining guidance

factors.action: Ask the responsible person to verify pump function and inspect for new ingress.
Ask the responsible person to assess rainfall context during ground inspection.
Ask the responsible person to arrange the overdue inspection and review repeated deferrals.
Ask a qualified person to review the recorded instability finding.
Ask the responsible person to review the post-blast inspection record; this factor does not estimate vibration.
Ask the responsible person to investigate increased pumping even if level is stable.
Ask the responsible person to verify advance and support records against the applicable standard.
Ask the responsible person to review the recorded incidents and near misses with the crew.
Seasonal context requires a reviewed site climatology; it cannot independently trigger an alert.
Obtain missing or current inputs; missing data is not evidence of reduced risk.

change_note: Experimental candidate: retain v0.2 pump windows and require each member of a corroborating pair to reach 0.25 normalized contribution. v0.2 allowed a nearly zero second factor to unlock an alert dominated by unrelated contributions. The 0.25 value is an unvalidated development choice selected after inspecting wet/dry scenarios; performance on those scenarios is not holdout validation.
